verdict: The most critical movement is a 100% drop in leads over the last 7 days, coinciding with a channel_dark:meta flag and a zero_spend_day, indicating Meta ads went fully dark and cut off the sole lead source. performance.verdict: Meta dark 6 days; pipeline intake broken; 5 overdue milestones threaten renewal.

findings.text: Meta has been $0 spend and 0 leads for 6 consecutive days (Sep 15–20), killing the sole lead source entirely.
5 SOW milestones overdue by up to 59 days: dashboard, attribution gap, sync cleanup, and renewal decision all unresolved as of Sep 21.
GHL shows 63 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, $0 value closed — pipeline intake is broken, not an ads problem.
3-day signal (Sep 18–20): spend $0, leads 0 vs prior 3 days (Sep 15–17) spend $56.43, leads 0 — Meta was already producing 0 leads before going dark on Sep 15.
GBP actions dropped 63% week-over-week; last 2 days show 0–1 actions, suggesting organic visibility is also degrading alongside paid.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta campaign immediately; $0 spend for 6 days has zeroed all 66 monthly leads.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been fully dark since Sep 15, with $0 spend and 0 leads across 6 consecutive days. Prior to blackout, the account was generating leads at $8.63 CPL on ~$25–34/day spend. Identify the cause (billing, policy violation, ad rejection, or account flag) and restore delivery. Success is confirmed when spend resumes at or above $20/day and leads return within 48 hours of restoration — check by Sep 23.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL pipeline intake: 63 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — leads are arriving but not converting to booked patients.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 63 opportunities created in 28 days with $895.86 in attributed value but 0 won and 0 appointments logged. This is an intake process failure, not an ads problem. Ahmed/Ali to audit the opp-to-appointment workflow in GHL — check contact owner assignment, follow-up automation status, and whether Lily or the new intake hire is actioning leads. Success metric: at least 1 confirmed appointment logged in GHL within 7 days of fix. Check by Sep 28.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP; 63% week-over-week drop and 0 actions on Sep 19–20 — re-check after Meta restores to isolate cause.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 63% week-over-week, with 0 actions on Sep 19 and 0 on Sep 20. This may be a knock-on effect of reduced paid traffic rather than an independent organic issue. Do not act on GBP in isolation until Meta is restored and at least 3 days of new paid traffic data is available. Re-check GBP trend on Sep 26 — if actions remain below 5/day with paid back on, escalate as a separate SEO/GBP finding.
